chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 357: Ji Ning Departs the Grand Xia World
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning receives Celestial Immortal Evergreen’s token but chooses a hidden path. He says goodbye to his cousin and leaves the Grand Xia World forever, entering the void with Patriarch Subhuti’s disciple.
og_title: Ji Ning Slips Away – Desolate Era Chapter 357
og_description: Ji Ning fakes a refusal to Celestial Immortal Evergreen, bids a tearful farewell to Yuchi Xiyue, and steps into the unknown with Patriarch Subhuti’s disciple.
twitter_title: Ji Ning vanishes from the Grand Xia – Chapter 357
twitter_description: A quiet goodbye, a riddle of the heart, and a void passage. Ji Ning is gone.

lore_anchors.definition: The secret cave-dwelling of Patriarch Subhuti in the Three Realms. Its name is a visual riddle: a slanted crescent and three stars form the Chinese character for “heart” (心), implying it can only be found with the heart.
A Pure Yang True Immortal and Sword Immortal of the Three Realms, junior apprentice-brother to the Grand Xia Emperor. He is known for being a recluse and was meant to take Ji Ning as a disciple.
The highest fame-grade of Ki Refining cultivators in the Three Realms, having fully comprehended a Grand Dao. Equivalent in narrative weight to a “Daofather” in certain contexts.
